sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Redistribution is permitted under CC0; retain source attribution in manifests.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch on demand; use entity revision IDs and create a new run to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: Wikidata QID is exact source identity. P1278 is a LEI crosswalk candidate and is bound only after checksum and ownership checks.
sources.mapping_rules: Map allowlisted P31 classes to core entity types. Labels and aliases generate lookup candidates only.
data_quality_checks: QID must match Q followed by digits.
Entity must have a non-empty English or Vietnamese label.
Unknown P31 classes are skipped rather than guessed.
LEI crosswalks must pass ISO 17442 check-digit validation.

sources.record_schema: GLEIF API v1 JSON:API LEI record; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Redistribution is permitted under CC0; do not imply GLEIF endorsement.
sources.freshness_policy: The API reports Golden Copy publication time; fetch on demand and refresh in a new run.
sources.identifier_rules: A valid LEI is the exact authoritative identifier namespace gleif-lei; names are candidate labels only.
sources.mapping_rules: Map legal name and other names to an Organization record; do not infer ownership from names.
data_quality_checks: Response LEI must match the requested LEI and pass ISO 17442 check-digit validation.
Legal name must be non-empty.
Entity status must be present and retained without filtering historical status semantics.

sources.record_schema: MediaWiki Action API extracts and revisions JSON; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store raw responses and extracted text as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: When redistributing derived content, preserve attribution and applicable share-alike terms.
sources.freshness_policy: Use the latest returned revision; record page ID, revision ID and revision timestamp.
sources.identifier_rules: Page ID plus revision ID identifies a document version; title matching never establishes entity identity.
sources.mapping_rules: Extract only explicit subsidiary-of statements into organization:subsidiaryOf; resolve the page subject by its Wikidata pageprops QID and the object through a unique exact alias. Use revision time as the earliest supported valid time for present-tense statements.
data_quality_checks: Page ID, revision ID, timestamp, title and non-empty text are required.
Assertion evidence span must equal the exact substring in the archived document text.
Unresolved or ambiguous subjects and objects are routed to review by the canonical pipeline.

sources.record_schema: OpenSky REST API /states/all state vector; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact bounded-area response as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Keep attribution and access conditions with the archived run manifest.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch one current snapshot per run; use time_position as valid time and retain snapshot time separately.
sources.identifier_rules: ICAO24 is the shared aircraft identifier across OpenSky, ADSB.lol, and adsb.fi. Match only on the exact ICAO24 value; never merge across sources on callsign or name.
sources.mapping_rules: Map valid, recent state vectors inside the Vietnam-SCS rectangular AOI to source-backed one-second location assertions. The AOI is not a political boundary.
data_quality_checks: State vector must include a valid ICAO24 address, source position time and finite coordinates.
Coordinates must fall inside the configured Vietnam-SCS area of interest.
Positions older than one hour or later than the snapshot time are skipped.
Callsigns and origin-country labels are retained only as reported metadata, not identity evidence.

sources.record_schema: ADSB.lol API v2 readsb-compatible aircraft response; schema 1
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact bounded-area response as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Attribute ADSB.lol and retain ODbL 1.0 obligations for redistributed database extracts.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch one current 250 nautical mile snapshot per run; derive position time from response now and seen_pos.
sources.identifier_rules: ICAO24 is the shared aircraft identifier across OpenSky, ADSB.lol, and adsb.fi. Match only on the exact ICAO24 value; never merge across sources on callsign or name.
sources.mapping_rules: Query a 250 nautical mile circle centered at 12.5N, 110E; map only recent positions revalidated inside the Vietnam-SCS AOI. Callsign and registration are reported metadata.
data_quality_checks: Require an integer Unix-millisecond snapshot time and a readsb aircraft list.
Require a six-digit ICAO24 address, finite coordinates and numeric seen_pos age.
Skip positions older than one hour, future-dated positions and coordinates outside the AOI.
Treat output as an overlapping ADS-B provider feed, not an independent confirmation of OpenSky or ADSB.fi.

sources.record_schema: adsb.fi Open Data API v3 readsb-compatible aircraft response; schema 1
sources.license: Operator-authorized use; adsb.fi public endpoint terms apply
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact bounded-area response as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve adsb.fi attribution; do not publish raw data without verifying the applicable source terms.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch one current 250 nautical mile snapshot per run; public endpoint pacing is at most one request per second.
sources.identifier_rules: ICAO24 is the shared aircraft identifier across OpenSky, ADSB.lol, and adsb.fi. Match only on the exact ICAO24 value; never merge across sources on callsign or name.
sources.mapping_rules: Use the current v3 regional endpoint, centered at 12.5N, 110E with a 250 nautical mile radius; map only recent positions revalidated inside the Vietnam-SCS AOI.
data_quality_checks: Require an integer Unix-millisecond snapshot time and a readsb aircraft list.
Require a six-digit ICAO24 address, finite coordinates and numeric seen_pos age.
Skip positions older than one hour, future-dated positions and coordinates outside the AOI.
Treat output as an overlapping ADS-B provider feed, not an independent confirmation of OpenSky or ADSB.lol.

sources.storage_policy: Store bounded stream windows as immutable content-addressed snapshots outside the repository; keep API credentials out of archives.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve AISStream attribution and the operator's access conditions with each run.
sources.freshness_policy: Collect a time-bounded live window; record local receipt time separately from the AIS UTC-second field.
sources.identifier_rules: MMSI is reusable and source-scoped; names and MMSI do not prove cross-source identity.
sources.mapping_rules: Archive validated in-area position reports as source documents. The AIS UTC-second value is not a full timestamp and is not converted into valid time.
data_quality_checks: Accept only PositionReport messages with Valid=true and a nine-digit MMSI.
Latitude and longitude must be finite and inside the configured Vietnam-SCS area of interest.
Do not create temporal assertions from the AIS second-within-minute field.
The feed is live and non-replayable; preserve received frames before mapping.

sources.record_schema: GDELT 2.0 Events tab-separated export, 61 columns; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact checksum-verified export as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository and map only regional rows.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve GDELT attribution and the original first-source URL when present.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch the newest export named by lastupdate.txt; event day has daily precision and DATEADDED is an ingestion timestamp.
sources.identifier_rules: GlobalEventID identifies a GDELT coded record, not a canonical real-world event or actor.
sources.mapping_rules: Filter by ActionGeo coordinates; keep CAMEO codes, geocoder centroid and first SOURCEURL as source-reported metadata. Register each mapped row as a document, not a verified fact.
data_quality_checks: Verify the export MD5 from the official latest-update manifest before parsing.
Require exactly 61 tab-separated fields, a numeric event ID and a valid YYYYMMDD event day.
Action latitude and longitude must be finite and fall inside the configured area of interest.
Retain GDELT's reported event date at daily precision and do not infer article text from SOURCEURL.

sources.record_schema: Overpass API JSON; selected port and harbor features; schema 1
sources.license: Operator-authorized access; OpenStreetMap ODbL attribution retained
sources.storage_policy: Store bounded query responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve OpenStreetMap attribution and applicable database terms.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch a current snapshot on demand; use a new run ID to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: OSM object type plus numeric ID identifies a source feature, not an organization or canonical entity.
sources.mapping_rules: Map selected amenity=port, seamark:type=harbour and harbour=yes objects to source documents with local coordinate checks.
data_quality_checks: Every mapped feature must have a node coordinate or way/relation center inside the configured area.
Retain OSM tags as reported metadata; do not infer operators, ownership or identity.
Bound the Overpass query by the regional box, timeout and response memory limit.

sources.record_schema: USGS GeoJSON weekly earthquake summary feed; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact GeoJSON response as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve USGS event identifiers and source URLs with registered reports.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch the current weekly feed on demand; use a new run ID to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: USGS feature ID identifies a catalog record, not a canonical hazard or impact assessment.
sources.mapping_rules: Locally filter GeoJSON epicenters to the regional AOI and register reports without inferring damage or impact.
data_quality_checks: Require a FeatureCollection and feature ID, properties, and point coordinates.
Coordinates must be finite and inside the configured area of interest.
Preserve source-reported magnitude, origin time, depth, status and URL without reinterpretation.

sources.record_schema: NASA FIRMS Area API VIIRS NOAA-20 CSV; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact bounded-area CSV as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository; never archive MAP_KEY.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve NASA FIRMS attribution and detection fields with each report.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch one UTC-day area response per run; use a new run ID to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: A source row hash identifies a detection record only; it is not a confirmed fire or incident identity.
sources.mapping_rules: Map valid VIIRS detection rows inside the regional AOI to source documents, not verified fire assertions.
data_quality_checks: Require latitude, longitude, acquisition date/time and satellite columns.
Coordinates must be finite and inside the configured area of interest.
Keep MAP_KEY in the request path only; redact it from logs, source URIs and raw manifests.

sources.record_schema: Global Fishing Watch API v3 events JSON; public-global-fishing-events latest; schema 1
sources.license: Operator-authorized API access; token and dataset terms apply
sources.storage_policy: Store bounded event responses as content-addressed snapshots outside the repository; keep bearer tokens out of archives.
sources.redistribution_policy: Preserve Global Fishing Watch attribution and applicable API dataset terms.
sources.freshness_policy: Fetch a bounded date window on demand; pin the window in the run configuration and use a new run ID to refresh.
sources.identifier_rules: GFW event and vessel IDs are provider-scoped references; vessel IDs are not cross-source merge evidence.
sources.mapping_rules: Map in-AOI fishing event reports as documents; treat vessel activity as modelled AIS-derived evidence, not ground truth.
data_quality_checks: Require an authenticated bounded query and an entries array.
Require event IDs and finite event positions inside the configured area.
Do not infer identity or truth from vessel names, event type or AIS-derived activity.

sources.record_schema: GDACS Events geteventlist/eventsbyarea GeoJSON FeatureCollection; schema 1
sources.storage_policy: Store the exact current event feed as a content-addressed snapshot outside the repository.
sources.redistribution_policy: Attribute the Global Disaster Awareness and Coordination System and preserve its disclaimers.
sources.freshness_policy: Query events intersecting the configured AOI for the most recent 4 days; the API permits up to 30 days.
sources.identifier_rules: Event type, event ID and episode ID identify a provider alert episode, not an independently verified real-world incident.
sources.mapping_rules: Request a rectangular WKT area filter and locally revalidate returned GeoJSON point coordinates before registering provider alert episodes as source documents.
data_quality_checks: Require a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with event type, event ID and point coordinates.
Coordinates must be finite and inside the configured area of interest.
Preserve alert level, event dates, modified time, source and affected-country labels as provider metadata.
The API returns events selected by spatial intersection; exclude returned centroids outside the local AOI.
